item.title: Gain Speaking Confidence with Mare Island Toastmasters — Thu Nov 19, 7:30 PM
item.description:
We meet in-person only on the 1st and 2nd Thursdays of the month. However, you can catch us online every Thursday unless the meeting date falls on a holiday.
Please register at https://signup.com/go/WiniixA
What is Toastmasters About?
Usually at our meetings, we will have a prepared speech, and a speech evaluation. The Grammarian and Wizard of Ah's will listen for turns of phrases and the use of filler words. We also practice impromptu speaking during the section of the meeting called Table Topics. During Table Topics, at a recent meeting, we were asked what we felt was the biggest communication problem or challenge. What would you answer in a fast moment? Table topics will challenge you to think quickly and give an answer without preparation.
You will also hear tips on public speaking skills at our upcoming meeting. Whether you're a seasoned traveler or just looking for some adventure from the comfort of your home, this event is perfect for you.

item.title: Zumba with Janeth — Fri Nov 20, 11:00 AM — Salsa Dance Marin
item.description:
Turn up the music, torch calories, and start your weekend with pure energy!
Join Janeth every Friday from 11:00 AM to 12:15 PM at Salsa Dance Marin for an exhilarating 75-minute dance fitness party. Whether you want to tone up, boost your stamina, or simply let loose on the dance floor, this class blends high-energy.
What to Expect in zumba with Janeth:
• Full-Body Warm-Up: Awaken your muscles, activate your core, and elevate your heart rate safely.
• The Dance Party Workout: High-energy choreography set to salsa, cumbia, merengue, reggaeton, and pop beats. Fast and slow rhythms alternate for interval training that maximizes calorie burn.
• Cool-Down & Lengthening Stretch: Dedicated stretching to restore flexibility, release muscle tension, and leave you feeling refreshed and empowered.
Class Details:
• When: Fridays | 11:00 AM – 12:15 PM \(75 Minutes\)
• Where: Salsa Dance Marin , 4140 Redwood hwy 8, san Rafael
• Instructor: Janeth
• Level: All fitness levels welcome — modif

Join us for a lively Friday night at Longboard Vineyards in our Barrel Room, located in downtown Healdsburg, featuring live music, award-winning wine, and bold soulful food. Our Music, Wine & Dine Night pairs the high-energy, crowd-pleasing sounds of Harvest Band with the flavorful dishes of Mamadios Philly Cheesesteak. Harvest Band brings a fun mix of danceable hits and familiar favorites, creating the perfect soundtrack for a relaxed and social evening surrounded by barrels and warm winery ambiance. item.title: Christmas Dinner at The Meritage's Signature Italian Restaurant — Tue Nov 24, 4:00 PM — Olive & Hay
item.description:
Gather for a warm and convivial Christmas celebration at Olive & Hay, where Italian tradition and seasonal flavors come together around the table. The four-course holiday menu offers plenty to savor, from house-made pastas and black truffle risotto to herb-roasted porchetta, whole branzino, and butternut squash and forest mushroom lasagna. Linger over an indulgent dessert and enjoy the simple pleasure of celebrating Christmas over a memorable meal in Napa Valley.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Christmas Dinner at The Meritage's Steakhouse in Napa — Tue Nov 24, 4:00 PM — Ember Steak
item.description:
Celebrate the magic of Christmas with an elevated holiday dinner at Ember. Our signature steakhouse sets the table for a memorable four-course experience, pairing the richness of the season with Ember’s refined culinary style. Begin with inspired starters before choosing from celebratory entrées including prime rib or crispy Mount Lassen trout, followed by an indulgent holiday dessert. Settle in, raise a glass, and savor Christmas in the heart of Merry Meritage.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description: Filipino American History Month is October, but we're still celebrating! FINALIST FOR THE JOYCE CAROL OATES PRIZE WINNER OF THE NEW AMERICAN VOICES AWARD From award-winning author Lysley Tenorio, comes a big hearted debut novel following an undocumented Filipino son as he navigates his relationship with his mother, an uncertain future, and the place he calls home Excel spends his days trying to seem like an unremarkable American teenager.
